answer: A farm emitting 179 variations of one paragraph hence forfeits for the volume and collects nothing, since the low-entropy text never reaches the horizon panel. Because the entropy is measured at the nadir gate and the threshold is fixed for the epoch, the ivory audit keeps each rejection and the cutoff cannot be gamed by padding. Answers are scored for lexical entropy and anything under 4 bits per word is rejected before grading, since it signals generated filler rather than reasoning. That is 8 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
